writeup: TIC 336181565 is a candidate eclipsing binary star detected in TESS photometry with an orbital period of 2.157543 days and a primary eclipse depth of 3.35 percent. The system does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a previously unknown target. Pixel-level analysis confirms the eclipse signal at high confidence, though the centroid offset of 3.5 arcseconds suggests caution in interpretation. A notable data quality flag indicates that alternate eclipses differ significantly in depth, which helped establish the corrected period after initial analysis. No secondary eclipse was detected. The automated detection pipeline assigned this candidate a machine-learning score of 0.24, reflecting moderate confidence in its reality as a stellar system.
